$comment: Resource pack format numbers and release ranges are sourced from https://minecraft.wiki/w/Pack_format (release table). Future version identifiers follow the 26.x naming scheme used by Minecraft Java Edition.

notes: Item model format supports per-sub-model transformation.
Entity textures moved into per-entity folders and some entity textures renamed.
Beds use block models and textures; the minecraft:beds atlas was removed.
core text shaders replaced by core/text and core/text_background.
Trim palette textures moved to textures/palettes/trim/.
Palette mcmeta files require a palette section with base_palette.
The map_color tint source type was removed.
